reason: The wedding means I really do need the house painted, and the price and pay-after-checking terms are fine for us. But this crew is new in Kochi with no Google reviews and nobody in my WhatsApp groups has used them. The founding-homes offer tells me there are no finished homes yet, so I will take the free site visit and still go with someone my neighbours have used.
objection: The guarantee only covers bubbling and peeling for 3 years. After a Kochi monsoon what I worry about is damp patches, seepage and the outside fading, and none of that is mentioned. With the wedding date fixed, ₹2,000 a day off does not help me if the house is half-done when relatives arrive.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to see two or three Kochi homes Turbolux has already finished and phone those owners, or read real Google reviews from them, along with a written guarantee that also covers dampness and seepage.
